document.abstract: Beginning with the regular roll film emulsion-coated on a length of clear support, which was sent to Mr. Edison for his first experiments, there have been many changes and improvements in the negative motion-picture films and the addition of positive films, sound-recording films and other special films which have themselves been improved from time to time, resulting in improved techniques and better motion pictures.
